C1667.title: n8n GitHub Webhook Trigger Missing Signature Verification Allows Event Forgery
C1667.summary: The GitHub Webhook trigger node in the n8n workflow platform does not implement HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. An attacker who knows the Webhook URL can send unsigned POST requests with arbitrary data to trigger workflows, thereby forging GitHub Webhook events.

references.title: Webhook Forgery on Github Webhook Trigger · Advisory · n8n-io/n8n · GitHub
